title: Authentication Provider Contract
description: Defines the expected interface for authentication providers across any stack

authenticate.description: Validates credentials and returns an authentication result

code_verifier.description: PKCE code verifier (RFC 7636), required alongside grant_type=authorization_code for public clients (mobile, SPA). The matching code_challenge/code_challenge_method are sent at the authorization redirect, which is out of scope for this token-endpoint contract.

acr_values.description: Optional OIDC Authentication Context Class Reference request, used to force step-up authentication (e.g. re-prompt for MFA). Set this from the `detail` of a platform-core/authorization/decision#properties.result.properties.obligations entry with type=step_up_auth, then retry authenticate.

validate_token.description: Validates an access token and returns claims

principal.description: Normalized identity. Field-for-field mirror of auth/contracts/token-verifier.schema.json#properties.verify.properties.output — kept inline (not $ref'd) because this repo's validator only resolves whole-schema $ref, not JSON-pointer fragments. Additive: raw claims remains available above for callers that need it.

revoke.description: Revokes a token (RFC 7009), e.g. on explicit logout.
